info.title: Vampire Princess Miyu (TV) (ITA)
info.synopsis: Miyu è una vampira a cui è stato affidato il compito di riportare gli Shinma, gli "dei-demoni", nell'oscurità senza tempo in cui erano stati relegati dagli uomini, timorosi della loro superiorità. Ma sono proprio i sentimenti negativi degli umani a permettere agli Shinma di tornare nel nostro mondo. Ma non tutti gli Shinma sono crudeli: alcuni non sono neppure coscienti della propria condizione, così come la madre di Miyu, che scoprì di essere una vampira solo alla nascita della figlia. E a sua volta Miyu scoprì di essere chi era a 13 anni per errore dello Shinma inviato a lei per eliminarla, Larva, che fu ridotto alla condizione di suo schiavo. Adesso Miyu vive come sorvegliante del mondo degli umani e quando è colta dalla "sete", colpisce le sue giovani vittime, scegliendo fra chi ha un dolore nel cuore e non ha speranza nel futuro.

episodes.title: Le zanne lo sanno
episodes.synopsis: A schoolgirl is found dead by a fellow student. He notices two teeth marks on her neck and sees another girl fleeing the scene. He convinces himself that the killer is obviously a vampire and the girl who ran away surly must be the killer. To his surprise, the girl (Miyu) turns out to be his new classmate...

episodes.title: Alla prossima stazione
episodes.synopsis: A girl is confronted by a man on the subway who offers to make her "beautiful". When the train later reaches a station, the girl is gone, but the passengers hear her cries from the tunnel. Miyu comes to another high school and finds some friends. They ride the subway and Miyu hears about how girls often disappear from the last car in the subway. Miyu decides to take the train alone.

episodes.title: Il richiamo della foresta
episodes.synopsis: After beginning her new school life at Tokiwa Gakuen, Miyu befriends classmates Chisato, Yukari and Hisae. When another student, Yuko, tells them about her brother, who seems to be suffering from bizarre nightmares since an ancient African mask was brought home, Miyu visits Yuko's house and immediately recognizes the mask to be a Shinma.

episodes.title: Arriva Reiha
episodes.synopsis: It's the beginning of the Showa era. Miyu spends the night at a lonely inn deep in the mountains, where she meets a man traveling with his daughter. The same night, Reiha arrives at the inn in disguise. She sees Miyu as her arch-enemy. The next day, the father and daughter set foot on a mountain from which no one has returned. Worried, Miyu goes after them with Reiha.

episodes.title: Ritratto in seppia
episodes.synopsis: Miyu, Chisato and a few others go to a movie screening held at Tokiwa University, where they meet an old assistant professor who also acts as advisor to the university's Cinema Club. They end up watching an old 8mm film he shot during his student years and learn that he is still in love with the leading lady who left the campus before the film's completion. Deeply moved, Chisato decides to find the woman in order to reunite the two.

episodes.title: Lo spettro di Miyu
episodes.synopsis: After returning from a graveyard, Miyu disappears from a cab just on a whim to scare the driver. But a rumor has spread that the driver was attacked and killed by an assailant who sucked his blood. Miyu begins to investigate, but is soon confronted by an unexpected enemy.

episodes.title: Destino
episodes.synopsis: Miyu encounters Kiyoshi and Kayo, a young brother and sister possessing supernatural powers. Not being able to live with others because of their gift, the two must stay on the road and live as vagabonds. Miyu sympathizes with them, but a tragedy ensues after they begin taking care of a stray dog.

episodes.title: Scarpette rosse
episodes.synopsis: Miyu's classmate Miho is slated to make her debut as a singer, after being discovered by the famous producer Takashi Kashiwara at an audition. However, the shy Miho has no confidence in herself, so Kashiwara gives her a pair of red shoes as a good luck charm. Miho overcomes her nervousness thanks to the shoes and becomes increasingly involved in her singing. But the shoes' effect doesn't stop there...

episodes.title: Casa tua
episodes.synopsis: A young childless couple decides to take in a cat belonging to a neighbor who recently died. The cat seemingly brings good luck to them, with the husband's business better than ever, and the couple are happier. Or so it seems. For the wife soon becomes fanatically attached to the cat, neglecting her job to take care of it.

Meanwhile, Miyu notices the existence of a Shinma in the area. When she heads for the lake with Reiha to investigate, they are confronted with an unexpected sight.

episodes.synopsis: A yakuza hit man undergoes plastic surgery after a failed assassination attempt. Thanks to the mysterious female surgeon, he wakes to find his face completely transformed. Determined to live a different life, he shows up in front of his ex-girlfriend with his new identity. Meanwhile, the city is haunted by a string of bizarre murders.

Miyu is left alone to fight a Shinma who attempts to kill her, but the Shinma, Ryu, was carrying a secret.

episodes.title: L'amore della fabbricante di bambole
episodes.synopsis: The doll artist Kasumi is famous for the beautiful boy figures she creates. A misanthrope who prefers to live only with her dolls, Kasumi treats her creations as if they were her lovers. But when she hires a young girl named Yuki as an assistant, her quiet and peaceful life begins to collapse. What is Yuki's intention?

episodes.title: Lo stendardo degli Shinma
episodes.synopsis: Miyu wanders into a mysterious village being attacked by the three stray Shinma brothers, who kill the villagers and vandalize their homes. On top of this, they demand that the village chief hand over his daughter Sato as their bride. Learning that the chief is a descendant of the Shinma protectors who once kept watch over the guardians, Miyu decides to help them.

episodes.title: Il racconto del passato di Miyu
episodes.synopsis: We're back in the Taisho era. Unaware of her true identity, Miyu is living with her mother as a normal girl. The annual show put on by the traveling theatre company is in the village, and all of the entertainers just adore Miyu. In the meantime, the stray Shinma tribe Tonbi is lurking in the shadows, plotting to kill Miyu off before she awakens as a guardian.

episodes.title: Il ragazzo che ritorna
episodes.synopsis: Not being able to adapt to high school life, the solitary Tokiya visits Hokkaido to heal his wounded heart. There, at a marsh, he encounters a golden bird who bestows on him the power of Shinma. Tokiya returns to the streets of Tokiwadai as an assassin with the mission of killing Miyu. Miyu recognizes his true motive in no time, and the two confront each other.
